breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the contradiction. It correctly calculated the axial velocity based on the inlet conditions (Va = 150 * cos(45) ≈ 106.07 m/s). However, it then restated the original, inconsistent outlet velocity (W2=100 m/s), which would imply a different axial velocity (Va = 100 * cos(30) ≈ 86.6 m/s). The ground truth resolves this by recalculating W2 to be consistent with the constant axial velocity. The agent simply kept both contradictory pieces of information.
